[[Song San Nok]] is a Canthan who, like most residents of Kaineng City, has become poor because of the plague.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Bukdek Byway}}

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Cantha]] will make it through any difficulty so long as the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor]] is alive."''

:''"Fruit can be hard to come by these days now that the  plague has slowed trade coming from [[Kryta]]."''

:''"The docks are so empty these days. People are afraid to come to Cantha."''

:''"The emperor cares greatly for all of us who have suffered because of the plague."'':

:''"The guards try to keep order but there are fewer of them each day."''

:''"The local guilds are taking over the streets. Most have bought off the [[Celestial Ministry|Ministry]] and do as they please."''

:''"The [[Luxon]]'' {{sic}} ''and [[Kurzick]]s have been quarreling for so long, I think they've probably forgotten why they started fighting to begin with."''

:''"The [[Celestial Ministry|Ministry of fire]]'' {{sic}} ''never seems incapable of understanding the plight of the common people."''

:''"The [[Obsidian Flame (guild)|Obsidian Flame]] help keep the rogue guilds in check."''

:''"Those [[Am Fah]] thugs are frightening!"''


==Quotes==
:''"Hear me fellow Canthans! This plague is only the beginning of our downfall!"''

:''"We have been defying the will of nature, now nature strikes back!"''

:''"This plague has spread through our lands like a wildfire. Like the wildfire, this plague will purify us."''

:''"Only the strongest of us will survive to see the final cataclysm."''

:''"The ones that died are the lucky ones, we  will have to struggle through the oncoming devastation."''

:''"There is no hope for any of us, we must accept our fate."''

:''"The future was decided long ago. The vengeance  of the [[undead]] is upon us!"''

:''"We can only delay the inevitable, we cannot stop it!"''
